findings.title: timeout launch path may kill by recycled process group
findings.body: PR-Agent warned that run_bounded backgrounds GNU timeout and later kills -$active_pid; if the timeout process exits and the PID is reused, the negative-PID kill could target an unrelated process group. It suggested capturing/verifying the process group explicitly.

findings.title: hosted probe can exhaust its own budget before gh probe
findings.body: PR-Agent warned that probe_hosted computes host_deadline before the CodeRabbit enablement check, so a slow enablement check can leave a zero or negative bound for the gh api probe and report check-inconclusive without attempting the hosted probe.

findings.title: probe_local relies on caller-initialized reason state
findings.body: PR-Agent noted that probe_local only clears reason on success and otherwise relies on the caller initialization. It recommended making the probe self-contained by setting reason explicitly in each branch.

adjudications.notes: Ronda local review reported clean on the same head; PR-Agent reported three possible issues. Human adjudication is required before classifying as a Ronda miss or reviewer noise. Local Ronda check-run publication failed because the Checks API requires GitHub App authentication for check-run creation.
